subject: Curated YouTube insights from Jahongir Pulatov's public channel

items.summary: In his channel introduction, Jahongir presents the channel as a place to share practical knowledge, real business experience, and content that should cause visible change in the viewer's life.

In his introduction video, Jahongir says he taught English from age 17, then turned that activity into a business at 20 after entering Westminster, which is one of the clearest public origin stories for Cambridge.
In the same founder-story video, he frames big goals as something shaped early by family culture and ties ambition to asking boldly, acting consistently, and staying inside ethical boundaries.
In his video on six business mistakes, Jahongir warns that one of the first mistakes is entering business with unrealistic expectations about speed, returns, and ease.
In the same business-mistakes video, he recommends consistent learning from the internet and practical study instead of waiting for perfect readiness before starting.
In the Selfmade entrepreneur series, Jahongir says one goal is to break the stereotype that success requires crooked methods, huge money, or elite connections.
items.source_title: Biznesni maqsadi pul emas, aksincha insonlar hayotini o'zgartirish - SHAHA DOLIMOV bilan suhbat

items.summary: In the same Selfmade format, he presents halal, correct, and relationship-aware business conduct as a core standard rather than a side topic.
items.source_title: Biznesni maqsadi pul emas, aksincha insonlar hayotini o'zgartirish - SHAHA DOLIMOV bilan suhbat

items.summary: In his Azon TV interview, Jahongir frames education as something that should be approached with larger ideas and social purpose, not only as a money-driven business.
items.source_title: Katta g'oyalar bilan ta'limga yondashishimiz lozim

items.summary: In that same education interview, he identifies the staffing and talent problem as one of the heaviest constraints across learning centers and education projects.
items.source_title: Katta g'oyalar bilan ta'limga yondashishimiz lozim

items.summary: In his university-risk video, Jahongir argues that the bigger risk is not university itself but entering without clarity and spending years on a path chosen emotionally or by inertia.
In the same university-risk video, he explains that goals mature from personal survival toward family, society, and service, and that stronger goals create stronger discipline.
In his networking video, Jahongir treats relationships as leverage that expands opportunity, learning, and business growth, not as empty socializing.
items.source_title: Ko'nikmalar #3 - Qanday qilib tanish-bilish orttirsa bo'ladi? Networking haqida!

items.summary: In his confidence video, Jahongir frames self-belief as something built through preparation, repeated action, and internal discipline rather than performance or empty positivity.
In his productivity video, Jahongir frames effectiveness as doing the right important work in a disciplined way, not just staying busy or looking active.
In his advice video for applicants and students, Jahongir treats exam preparation as a practical discipline problem and focuses on readiness, calmness, and process.

In his TEAM University discussion, Jahongir engages the question of whether entrepreneurs need university and treats formal education as useful when it is tied to direction, environment, and application.
In the Selfmade Tadbirkor series, Jahongir uses local founder stories to show that young people can build serious businesses without waiting for perfect conditions.
items.source_title: "SELFMADE TADBIRKOR" - Safia qandolat uyi asoschilaridan Bekzod Samigjanov bilan suhbat
